title: Kitchen
snippet:
@@ -4,4 @@ (3 before, 5 after)

Twist the mesh basket out at the bottom, rinse the grease off it under the hot
tap every month and push it back until it clicks.

title: Garden
snippet:
@@ -4,4 @@ (3 before, 5 after)

gate there shuts at four.
